scientific_question: Can an equal-budget hierarchical multilinear map with an independent output-side state represent sparse-MoE c_proj residual writes where feature-derived maps and a globally separable rank-two Kronecker sum fail?

theory_reconciliation.independent_output_requirement: The two-seed unseen-neuron oracle showed that even a full-c_proj-size dense map from terminal c_fc plus c_fc motion recovers only 2.20 percent of heldout routed write function. The write map must own independent output-oriented state.
theory_reconciliation.kronecker_boundary: The learned rank-two Kronecker image improved about 0.093 over a larger static FHT control but stopped at 0.333-0.334 heldout recovery. Its global two-term separability, not merely fixed orientation, is the remaining tested restriction.
theory_reconciliation.new_topology: A matrix-product-operator tensor train distributes learned output/input coupling across five radix levels. Every core is latent state; changing any core changes the tangent image. This is hierarchical multilinear entanglement rather than a sum of two globally separable products.
theory_reconciliation.not_lora: The constraint is low tensor-train bond rank, not low ordinary matrix rank. An interleaved MPO can materialize a full-rank 768x1536 matrix, and no dense adapter or learned output dictionary is stored.
theory_reconciliation.equal_budget: Rank nine over physical modes (3x6),(4x4)^4 uses 4,194 values per expert, fewer than the rejected rank-two Kronecker map's 4,352 and inside the paper-relevant 200-500x range.
theory_reconciliation.paper_link: The cores are the compact layer/matrix-wise latent state and materialize the target matrix through a smooth nonlinear map. A representability pass is still required before Mapping Loss, causal basis acquisition, or training can be meaningful.

source.target: With terminal same-run router and c_fc fixed, represent only terminal c_proj minus exact reproducible step-zero c_proj in the terminal hidden-state functional gauge.

mechanism.name: rank9_interleaved_mpo
mechanism.fixed_base: Exact GPT-seeded step-zero dense c_proj, immutable and reproducible from model seed.
mechanism.latent_state: All five MPO cores; no dense decoder, learned dictionary, LoRA residual, target-gradient state, token-conditioned inference branch, or uncounted basis.
mechanism.ordinary_rank: The interleaved MPO does not impose bond rank nine on the ordinary output-by-input matrix unfolding and may materialize ordinary rank 768.

functional_protocol.score: Exact routed residual-write recovery on untouched heldout tokens and heldout action agreement between independently refined discovery fits.
functional_protocol.controls: The sealed 4,352-coordinate rank-two Kronecker map is the primary equal-budget learned-image control; the 4,608-coordinate static three-factor FHT is a favorable fixed-image control.

fit.initialization: Exact per-expert rank-nine TT-SVD of the terminal c_proj displacement. Endpoint access deliberately makes this an optimistic representability upper bound, not a causal training simulation.
fit.functional_refinement: Independently refine all five cores on each discovery bank with full-batch Adam against normalized routed residual-write error.
fit.anti_leakage: The endpoint orients only this upper bound. Heldout tokens do not affect modes, rank, initialization policy, optimizer, checkpoint selection, or thresholds.

decision_rule.pass: Passing both independent fits authorizes only a separately preregistered causal online output/error-frame acquisition oracle for this exact MPO layout. It does not authorize model training, MFU, generated experts, or a larger rung.
decision_rule.fail: Reject the rank-nine five-core MPO at 281x. Do not sweep rank, radix layout, learning rate, optimizer, or seed. Return to theory on whether the 200-500x c_proj objective is compatible with the measured write-direction entropy.
decision_rule.scope: This is an equal-budget topology discriminator against the Kronecker map, not an arbitrary tensor-decomposition search.

execution.policy: Run focused synthetic tests and an exact-shape no-scientific-value performance preflight. Foreground-poll only if estimated under five minutes; otherwise attach a persistent terminal/error watchdog with an event-specific @Codex callback.
